alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 13 at 12:15PM PST until November 14 at 4:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 5 to
7 feet with sets 8 to 10 feet along west-facing beaches. For the
Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding expected,
particularly along west-facing beaches where surf will be
highest.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, from 4 PM this afternoon to
10 AM PST Sunday. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 7 AM to
4 PM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Dangerous swimming and
surfing
